summary: Human conversations send output shows the existing delivery status after durable acceptance, including stopped-recipient and host delivery diagnostics when available.

schema.detail: No SQLite tables, indexes, store versions or claim fields change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Human send output keeps the message ID first, then prints the existing status endpoint's phase and reason. Sent or staged mail is labelled queued. One optional status read has a two-second deadline; failure or timeout leaves the ID-only success output. The durable-send exit status remains successful. JSON receipts and client-v0 are unchanged, and JSON mode performs no extra status read.

recovery.detail: An older CLI prints the message ID without the added delivery line; messages and receipts remain unchanged.
